description.value: You've synced and tuned your augmentations, allowing them to power each other. If one of your augmentations is out of limited uses, you can squeeze out one more use by drawing power from other augmentations that haven't expended all of their limited uses or don't have limited uses. The item level of the augmentation used for power must match or exceed the item level of the augmentation powered in this way. Exceeding the powered augmentation's level doesn't give any other benefit. For example, you can power a 3rd-level augmentation with a 5th-level augmentation, but it would still be considered an effect from a 3rd-level item. The augmentations used for power as well as the augmentation powered in this way then lose functionality until your next daily preparations.
